thread:
maria: Quick sync on the 42B onboarding — weights uploaded, tokenizer oddness, and attention checks.

maria: @kevin where are the final weight shards? I only see interim ones in s3://redwood-models/42b/tmp

kevin: weights are now in s3://redwood-models/42b/release/v1 -- pattern: 42b-0000-of-0016.index + .bin shards. checksum posted in CI artifacts.

maria: got it, thx. seeing weird tokenization: punctuation getting split into separate tokens more than expected. aj any thoughts?

aj: tokenizer uses byte-level BPE with legacy pretokenizer. There's a special token for long hyphen sequences. Try using the provided tokenizer.json from the release dir, not the one in the model repo.

aj: config snippet:
```
"tokenizer_path": "s3://redwood-models/42b/release/v1/tokenizer.json",
"do_lower_case": false,
"use_legacy_pretokenizer": true
```

sophie: heads-up: model was trained with RoPE scaling (rope_freq_scale=0.5) — runtime default is 1.0. If you don't set rope_scale it misaligns attention and you get hallucinations.

sophie: set `rope_scale: 0.5` in the model config or use `--rope-mode scaled` in the CLI. Also for MQA we need `sliding_window: true` and `kv_stride: 128` to match training.

deploy-bot: checksum ok for s3://redwood-models/42b/release/v1 (sha256: abcdef123...)

kevin: adding a ci smoke test we can run locally:
```
./runtime/bin/smoke_test --model s3://redwood-models/42b/release/v1 \
  --rope-scale 0.5 --sliding-window --kv-stride 128 --input "The quick brown fox"
```

maria: nice. can someone glance at the runtime PR? #2345 has the rope scaling and sliding window flags. cc @aj @sophie :eyes:

aj: reviewing now, left two small comments about defaulting to flash_attn vs legacy for CPU fallback.

sophie: LGTM after aj's comments. Also recommend adding a small eval prompt set so we can detect regressions on RoPE scaling (prompt: incrementing sequence lengths).

maria: plan: merge once PR addressed, run nightly eval, then canary to dedicated pool tomorrow. thanks all :shipit:
